original_article.description: The company has finally set a date for the first customer deliveries of what CEO RJ Scaringe has said is "maybe the most important thing we’ve launched to date."
original_article.research:
[Lähde: TechCrunch]
Rivian has finally revealed that the first customers of the company’s new R2 SUV will get their vehicles on June 9.

The automaker has spent the last few months ramping up its efforts to release the R2, which is more affordable and aimed at a larger market than its current R1 lineup. The new SUV will initially be available in a trim that starts just under $60,000, though Rivian has announced plans to release a “standard” version that starts at $48,490 in 2027.

---

[Lähde: The Verge]
Rivian R2, R3, and R3X launch event: the EV company’s more affordable SUVs are here

While a few Rivian employees have already received their R2s, the first customer deliveries won’t start until next month. Rivian says order invitations to R2 reservation holders will start to go out on “a rolling basis,” with current R1T and R1S owners getting first priority. The first version to get delivered will be the R2 Performance with Launch Package ($59,485), followed by R2 Premium ($55,485) in late 2026. Once your order is confirmed, delivery should take 2-6 weeks, the company says.

---

[Lähde: Electrek]
Rivian has opened the online configurator for the R2, its critical mid-size electric SUV, giving reservation holders their first chance to spec out the vehicle ahead of deliveries. The Performance trim starts at $57,990 — just under Tesla’s Model Y Performance at $58,880.

The configurator launch comes ahead of Rivian’s previously communicated June timeline, signaling confidence in the R2 production ramp at its Normal, Illinois factory.

The R2 is the most important vehicle in Rivian’s lineup. While the R1S and R1T established the brand, they were always too expensive to move the kind of volume Rivian needs to reach profitability. The R2 changes that equation, and the configurator gives us our first detailed look at exactly what buyers will get — and what they’ll pay.

Rivian is rolling out the R2 in three trims, but only one is available to configure right now:

---

[Lähde: USA TODAY]
Rivian has delayed the arrival of the $45,000 version of its upcoming electric SUV, R2, which company officials say will be crucial to its long-term future as a viable automaker.

The Irvine, California-based company says in a post on its website that the $45,000 version of the electric SUV it intends to be its most affordable model will now be released in 2027. The company said it will begin releasing more expensive versions of the vehicle in the first half of 2026.

The news comes as Rivian announced in an X post on May 15 that the configurator for the R2 is live on its website and visitors there can now "explore paint colors, interior wheels and more" as it prepares to launch the new vehicle.

The least expensive version of the R2 is expected to start around $45,000 and be released in the 2027.

Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe said in a Jan. 29 appearance on the "On with Kara Swisher" podcast that the R2 is important to his company's plans to scale up into becoming a mass market electric vehicle producer.

"Rivian isn't being designed just for R1," Scaringe said. "If the goal is to build a company that's only going to make 15,000 cars a year, it would look very different as a business. But we've really invested in the business, contemplating and planning for Rivian to be a much larger company. And so because of that, R2 does need to be successful to support the rate of capital construction of the business because of how much tech we're developing and how much infrastructure we're building."

Car and Driver said in a review of the R2 prototype it test-drove that the EV was "powered by a permanent-magnet electric motor on each axle with a combined output of 656 horsepower and 609 pound-feet of torque."

More about the R2: Rivian CEO teases R2 electric SUV. Why it could be a big disruptor in 2026

"The ride is a bit more refined than the R1S, because the tires don't have to run at as high a pressure to support the mass, plus the lower body height lessens your perception of how much the vehicle rolls in corners," the website said. "And yes, it does go around corners."

In a review posted after doing its own test drive of the R2 prototype, the website InsideEVs.com said the electric SUV "packs more than 300 miles of range, 656 horsepower, 609 lb-ft of torque, and a 0 to 60 mph time of 3.6 seconds."

Just a few weeks ago, Rivian sounded like a proud parent welcoming its newborn as the first production R2 rolled off the production line. Now, company CEO RJ Scaringe has hinted that the lineup could grow beyond the R2 Performance and Launch Edition all-electric SUVs. He was not referring to the Standard trim due next year. According to Reuters, additional not-yet-seen versions are coming.

The Reuters interview focused on the possibility of a pickup version of the R2 electric SUV. payload.title: Rivian aloittaa R2-sähkökatumaasturin asiakastoimitukset 9. kesäkuuta
payload.summary: Rivian on asettanut ensimmäisille R2-sähkökatumaasturin asiakastoimituksille päivämäärän: toimitusten on määrä alkaa 9. kesäkuuta. Malli on yhtiölle keskeinen askel kohti laajempaa sähköautomarkkinaa.
payload.content:
Rivian aloittaa ensimmäiset R2-sähkökatumaasturin asiakastoimitukset 9. kesäkuuta, mikä tekee yhtiön pitkään odotetusta edullisemman kokoluokan mallista seuraavan merkittävän vaiheen sen kasvusuunnitelmassa. Toimitusten alku koskee yhtiön mukaan ensimmäisiä asiakkaita, vaikka jo osa Rivianin työntekijöistä on saanut R2-autoja ennen varsinaisten julkisten asiakastoimitusten käynnistymistä.

## R2 on Rivianille strateginen malli

Rivianin toimitusjohtaja RJ Scaringe on kuvannut R2:ta yhtiölle poikkeuksellisen tärkeäksi lanseeraukseksi. Mallin merkitys liittyy siihen, että Rivian pyrkii laajentumaan nykyistä suuremmille markkinoille ja kasvamaan kohti massamarkkinoiden sähköautovalmistajaa.

R2 sijoittuu Rivianin mallistossa edullisempaan ja laajemmin tavoiteltavaan luokkaan kuin yhtiön aiemmat R1T- ja R1S-mallit. Varausten haltijoille lähetetään tilauskutsuja vaiheittain, ja nykyiset R1T- ja R1S-omistajat saavat etusijan. Kun tilaus on vahvistettu, toimitusajan on kerrottu olevan noin 2–6 viikkoa.

Ensimmäisenä toimituksiin tulee R2 Performance Launch Package -versiona, jonka hinnaksi on ilmoitettu 59 485 dollaria. R2 Premium -version on määrä seurata myöhemmin vuonna 2026, ja sen hinnaksi on kerrottu 55 485 dollaria. Malliston edullisimman version odotetaan alkavan noin 45 000 dollarista ja saapuvan vuonna 2027.

## Yhtiö hakee toimituksiin selvää kasvua

Rivian laskee R2:n varaan merkittävän osan lähikuukausien kasvustaan. Yhtiön on kerrottu ennakoivan toimituksiinsa 53 prosentin nousua ja noin 23 000 R2-auton myyntiä. Alle puolet tästä määrästä liittyisi Uberin kanssa tehtyyn sopimukseen, jonka mukaan Uber aikoo lisätä täysin autonomisia R2-autoja robottaksipalveluunsa vuodesta 2028 alkaen.

R2:n toimitusten aloitus on siksi Rivianille enemmän kuin yksittäisen mallin lanseeraus. Se testaa samalla, pystyykö yhtiö kasvattamaan tuotantoa, palvelemaan varausjonoa ja viemään brändiään laajemmalle asiakaskunnalle. Rivian ei ole antanut yksityiskohtaisia kommentteja mahdollisista tulevista R2X-versioista tai R3-mallin aikataulusta, vaan on korostanut keskittyvänsä R2:n lanseeraukseen ja julkisten asiakastoimitusten käynnistämiseen.
summary_bullets: Rivianin R2-sähkökatumaasturin ensimmäiset asiakastoimitukset alkavat 9. kesäkuuta.
Ensimmäisenä toimituksiin tulee R2 Performance Launch Package, ja edullisempia versioita seuraa myöhemmin.
Rivian pitää R2:ta keskeisenä mallina kasvulleen ja laajentumiselleen massamarkkinoille.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu paketin useisiin lähdekatkelmiin. Tulevia R2X- ja R3-tietoja käsiteltiin varovaisesti, koska yhtiö ei ole vahvistanut niitä.

The company has finally set a date for the first customer deliveries of what CEO RJ Scaringe has said is "maybe the most important thing we’ve launched to date."

Rivian R2, R3, and R3X launch event: the EV company’s more affordable SUVs are here While a few Rivian employees have already received their R2s, the first customer deliveries won’t start until next month. Rivian says order invitations to R2 reservation holders will start to go out on “a rolling basis,” with current R1T and R1S owners getting first priority. The first version to get delivered will be the R2 Performance with Launch Package ($59,485), followed by R2 Premium ($55,485) in late 2026. Once your order is confirmed, delivery should take 2-6 weeks, the company says. ---

The least expensive version of the R2 is expected to start around $45,000 and be released in the 2027. Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe said in a Jan. 29 appearance on the "On with Kara Swisher" podcast that the R2 is important to his company's plans to scale up into becoming a mass market electric vehicle producer.

Rivian is counting on the R2 to drive sales in the coming months. The company has forecasted a 53-percent jump in deliveries and expects to sell about 23,000 R2s. Just under half of those are expected to come through its deal with Uber, which plans to add fully autonomous R2s to its robotaxi service beginning in 2028. We reached out to Rivian about the rumored R2X variants and the future of the R3, which had been expected to launch for the 2027 or 2028 model year, alongside or shortly after the R2. It would be a shame to lose such a promising, stylish, 1980s hatchback-inspired SUV.
